stays.headline: Vione, quiet design and your own pool
paras: Vione is the kind of hotel that quietly impresses you. Clean architecture, understated interiors and a calm, adults-focused feel, with every detail considered.
Naoussa's old port is ten minutes away for dinner, and the beach clubs and Antiparos are an easy hop.

card.label: Your suite · 4 nights
rows: Junior Suite, private plunge pool, panoramic sea view
card.perks: Welcome amenity, €100 food and beverage credit, early check-in or late check-out and an upgrade when available.
card.fine: Non-refundable. Climate fee €15 a night, paid at checkout. Check-in 3PM, check-out 11AM.

stays.headline: Andronis Arcadia, a pool on your own terrace
paras: Every room at Arcadia has its own pool, some of the largest on the island, and it sits just outside Oia with sunset-facing suites and very private layouts.
It has more energy than most of Oia, with Beefbar and Pacman on property, so dinner can be a night out without leaving the hotel.
